async def act(page):
    import asyncio

    # No knowledge-base helper functions are available for this task (the <functions> block is empty),
    # so all interactions are done with Playwright accessibility selectors.

    # Helpers that only use accessibility-centric APIs
    async def try_click_role_names(names, timeout=2000):
        """Try clicking buttons/controls by get_by_role with several name variants."""
        for name in names:
            try:
                await page.get_by_role("button", name=name).click(timeout=timeout)
                return True
            except Exception:
                continue
        return False

    async def try_click_role_pairs(pairs, timeout=2000):
        """Try clicking controls by various (role, name) pairs."""
        for role, name in pairs:
            try:
                await page.get_by_role(role, name=name).click(timeout=timeout)
                return True
            except Exception:
                continue
        return False

    async def try_fill(labels, value):
        for lbl in labels:
            try:
                await page.get_by_label(lbl).fill(str(value))
                return True
            except Exception:
                continue
        return False

    async def try_select(labels, option_label=None, option_value=None):
        for lbl in labels:
            try:
                locator = page.get_by_label(lbl)
                if option_label is not None:
                    await locator.select_option(label=option_label)
                elif option_value is not None:
                    await locator.select_option(value=option_value)
                else:
                    return False
                return True
            except Exception:
                continue
        return False

    # 1) Dismiss blocking popup using accessibility selectors only.
    # Try several likely accessible names for the popup close control.
    popup_button_names = ["×", "✖", "Close", "close", "Dismiss", "OK", "Close dialog", "Close popup"]
    await try_click_role_names(popup_button_names, timeout=1000)

    # Also try other roles that might represent the close control (some UIs use generic buttons/links)
    other_variants = [("button", "×"), ("button", "✖"), ("button", "Close"), ("link", "Close")]
    await try_click_role_pairs(other_variants, timeout=1000)

    # Press Escape as a fallback to dismiss overlays (allowed and not a CSS-based selector)
    try:
        await page.keyboard.press("Escape")
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Small pause to let popup disappear
    await asyncio.sleep(0.35)

    # 2) Click the Continue button using the full accessibility path: row "Continue" -> button "Continue".
    # This follows the requirement to use the full .get_by_role() path for a button that belongs to an element.
    try:
        await page.get_by_role("row", name="Continue").get_by_role("button", name="Continue").click()
    except Exception:
        # Fallback: try any Continue button accessible by role
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Continue").click()

    # Wait for the product form to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.6)

    # 3) Fill the main product fields for the simple product
    await try_fill(["Name", "Product Name"], "Energy-Bulk Man Yoga Pant")
    await try_fill(["SKU"], "ENERGY-BULK-MAN-YOGA-PANT")
    await try_fill(["Price"], "69.99")
    # Weight is commonly required for simple products
    await try_fill(["Weight"], "1")

    # 4) Set selects: Status -> Enabled, Visibility -> Catalog, Search
    await try_select(["Status"], option_label="Enabled")
    await try_select(["Visibility"], option_label="Catalog, Search")

    # 5) Set attribute options: Color -> Yellow ; Size -> 38
    await try_select(["Color"], option_label="Yellow")
    await try_select(["Size"], option_label="38")

    # 6) Open Inventory tab/section if present and set stock values
    inventory_variants = [("tab", "Inventory"), ("link", "Inventory"), ("button", "Inventory"), ("link", "Inventory Information")]
    await try_click_role_pairs(inventory_variants, timeout=1000)
    await asyncio.sleep(0.35)

    await try_fill(["Qty", "Quantity", "Qty*"], "50")
    await try_select(["Manage Stock"], option_label="Yes")
    await try_select(["Stock Availability", "Is in Stock", "In Stock"], option_label="In Stock")

    # 7) Save the product. Try Save in common parent contexts and global Save fallback.
    save_attempted = False
    save_names = ["Save", "Save Product", "Save and Continue Edit"]
    for name in save_names:
        # try within common action group first
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("group", name="Page Actions").get_by_role("button", name=name).click()
            save_attempted = True
            break
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("toolbar").get_by_role("button", name=name).click()
            save_attempted = True
            break
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name=name).click()
            save_attempted = True
            break
        except Exception:
            continue

    if not save_attempted:
        # final fallback: try a generic Save button by role
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
            save_attempted = True
        except Exception:
            pass

    if not save_attempted:
        raise Exception("Could not find a Save button to click")

    # Allow time for save to process (navigation expected)
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
